description: This PHP source file defines a custom exception class 'KpiServiceException' within the OrangeHRM Performance module namespace. It extends the built-in Exception class and includes a static method for generating a specific exception related to KPI rating validation.

classes.name: KpiServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class for KPI service-related errors, providing a specific static method to indicate when the minimum rating exceeds the maximum rating.

methods.name: minGreaterThanMax
methods.description: A static factory method that creates an instance of 'KpiServiceException' with a message indicating that the minimum rating should be less than the maximum rating.
